description: EFC (I) Limited engages in the provision of real estate services in India and internationally. It operates through the Rental, Interior, and Furniture segments. The company engages in the development, buying, selling, leasing, operation, and management of managed office and coworking spaces; provision of turnkey interior design and execution solutions, as well as interior designing consultancy; manufacturing and supplying furniture for commercial and other spaces; and manufactures, sells, purchases, imports, and exports furniture and fixtures. It also provides property management and renting or leasing services involving its own or leased non-residential properties. The company serves entrepreneurs, small and medium enterprises, and enterprise clients. The company was formerly known as Amani Trading and Exports Limited. EFC (I) Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Pune, India.
